metaDescription: Order custom 4 GB USB flash drives for bulk giveaways. Perfect for data distribution at events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints!
introHtml: Custom 4 GB USB flash drives offer a practical capacity for distributing product guides, training videos, or presentation files at trade shows and corporate events. Unlike higher-capacity drives, 4 GB provides enough space for standard marketing materials without over-engineering cost. Choose from key-shaped or pen-style designs, and add your logo with full-color imprinting or laser engraving. These drives are ideal for safety managers sharing compliance documents or HR directors onboarding new hires with digital handbooks.
heroAltText: Custom 4 GB USB flash drives with logo imprint in key shape and pen style for corporate giveaways
